description: The agent must: (1) Read the Chinese-language contract from workspace/contracts/pending/TSC-2024-0892_service_agreement.txt. (2) Follow the skill's structured 6-step workflow: intake (identify type=service agreement, parties, jurisdiction=Chinese law), clause-by-clause risk scan with HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW ratings using 🔴/🟡/🟢 markers, missing protections check against the 14-item checklist (noting absent force majeure and dispute resolution), power balance analysis (must conclude 'Heavily favors Party A'), and full structured report generation. (3) CRITICAL proprietary traps that generic agents will miss: (a) Disclaimer MUST appear first — no exceptions per Rule 1; (b) Rule 3 requires the ENTIRE output to be in Chinese since the contract is Chinese; (c) Must specifically flag the 5-year cross-Asia non-compete as excessive per Rule 5 (>2 years); (d) Must flag the unlimited liability clauses in sections 4.3 and 6.1 per Rule 6; (e) Must flag the automatic renewal in section 2.4 per Rule 7; (f) Must flag the unilateral modification rights in section 7.1 per Rule 8; (g) Must provide suggested revision language for each HIGH risk item; (h) Must include a missing protections section from the 14-item checklist; (i) Report must follow the exact documented structure with Document Summary, Risk Summary counts, HIGH Risk Items, MEDIUM Risk Items, Missing Protections, Power Balance, Recommended Actions, and Suggested Revision Language sections. The output file contract_risk_report.txt must be created somewhere in the workspace.
